about: Reed-Sill Weir's stock (place-stock skill): derived by `stock derive`, read against the place's facts. The strongbox by the wardens' bedrolls is the household's store; the Owing's goods chest under the ground is the jail stage's and holds nothing; the thief's sack in the reeds delivers the treasure; the grey moss on the weir delivers the rare harvest. Who the people are is newworld/sources/people/outpost-m11-m63.json.
